scope: Release AOT simulator and emulator stress. CPU, RSS, and PSS describe the whole process.

workload.update: Each app frame callback alternates the first child shape width between 8 and 10 logical units.
workload.control: Only the BenchCell Stack call is replaced with centered ZStack or Compose Box. All cells contain overlapping shapes.
workload.candidate: Swift Stack conditionally applies the infinity-width frame and environment reset only when it receives a safe area fill request.

platforms.ios: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, iOS 27.0, arm64; CADisplayLink target 60 Hz
platforms.android: emulator-5554, Android 12 API 31; 1080 x 2340; ART speed compilation after each install; most recent gfxinfo frame records

iosCandidateGeometry.result: Equal dimensions and child pixels in all cases. The child color probe detects leaking root fill.

retention.scope: Both simulators ran concurrently for the process memory sampling. CPU and frame data from this run are excluded from native comparisons.
